title: Be aliyin be ali
body:
Ali.. Ali.. Ali.. Ali..
Ali.. Ali.. Ali.. Ali..
Ali.. Ali.. Ali.. Haider

Haider Ali Ali
Ali, Ali, Ali, Ali, Ali, Ali
Ali, Ali, Ali, Ali, Ali, Ali
Naade ali padhte raho..
Jhoom ke tum kehte raho
Hai ye malango ka wazifa....
Be aliyin , be aliyin, be aliyin, be ali

2. Rab ne jab adam o hawwa ko zamee'n par bheja
phir farishto'n ne unhe wird naya samjhaya
us wasile se dua maangi, hui khatm saza
tab ye adam ne kaha..
Be aliyin , be ali
hogaya raazi khuda
Be aliyin, be ali

kyu na kahu phir mai jaabaja

3. Naade ali aayi Mohammad ke labo'n par
Aaye ali qatl hue marhab o antar
toda jo angusht se darwaza e khaibar
gunji maida'n me sada
Be aliyin, be ali
deen e haq jeet gaya
be aliyin, be ali

4. Sau(100) baar le gayi sare bazaar muflisi
har baar maine apna aqeeda bacha liya
maine padhi thi apne hifazat ke waaste

5. Zikr tera tere malango ki ibadat

mai fazao'n mein uda

6. Arsh pe jo pohche nabi dekha ye manzar

be aliyin, be ali
ye jaha'n khalq hua
be aliyin, be ali

teri ziyarat se hui

7. Chhoda jo fizza ne habash ek dua ki
takht nahi chahiye zahra ki kaneezi

8. Kehte hai duniya se yehi buzar o salman

be aliyin, be ali
